content.about: The Republic of the Congo sits on the equator in Central Africa, with rainforests, rivers and a short Atlantic coast. Its capital, Brazzaville, faces Kinshasa across the Congo River. It is home to gorillas and chimpanzees. Congolese rumba music is famous across Africa.

standout.text: Odzala-Kokoua National Park is a stronghold of western lowland gorillas.

didYouKnow: Brazzaville and Kinshasa are the closest pair of capital cities in the world.
About two-thirds of the country is forest.
Congolese rumba is on UNESCO's list of intangible heritage.
